paragraphs.text: Swimming in rivers and lakes has become popular again. Clubs report that most new members are over forty, and many say they started during the winter, when the water is coldest.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Doctors advise caution. Cold water can cause the body to gasp, which is dangerous far from the bank, and swimmers are told to enter slowly and never to swim alone. There is no national record of accidents.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: most new members are over forty
items.prompt: Most people who join swimming clubs are young.

explanation.en: Most new members are over forty → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Жаңа мүшелердің көбі қырықтан асқан → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Большинство новых членов — старше сорока → FALSE.

items.quote: swimmers are told to enter slowly and never to swim alone
items.prompt: Swimmers are advised to go into the water slowly.

explanation.kk: «told to enter slowly» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «told to enter slowly» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.

items.quote: There is no national record of accidents
items.prompt: The number of accidents has fallen in recent years.

explanation.en: There is no record at all, so nothing is said about a fall → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Жазатайым оқиға туралы дерек мүлде жоқ, сондықтан азаю туралы да айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Данных о несчастных случаях нет вовсе, значит и о снижении сказать нечего → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: Cold water can cause the body to gasp
items.prompt: Cold water can make a swimmer gasp.

explanation.en: “Cold water can cause the body to gasp” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «Cold water can cause the body to gasp» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «Cold water can cause the body to gasp» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
